title: Power-Sizing Simulation Specification for Protocol v1.4.0 Decision Rule B
chronological_note: This specification artifact was committed in commit 259b78f, after the simulation result was already present in commit c481fb3. The timestamp recorded here reflects the wall-clock time of documentation, not a prospective pre-registration freeze. The simulation result is therefore not covered by a prospective registration guarantee. Future studies must commit a frozen specification file prior to executing the simulation to satisfy prospective pre-registration standards.

governance_binding.decision_rule: Decision Rule B (Prespecified N=220, Require Clopper-Pearson LCB >= 90.0%)
governance_binding.cohort_scope: Confirmatory Cohort 3 Sizing Simulation under Declared Scenario Assumptions

calibrated_scenario_assumptions.baseline_wer_mean_note: Arithmetic mean of the six per-accent hardcoded baseline WERs in simulate_design_stage_joint_power() (paired_cluster_inference.py lines 251-258). The previously documented value of 27.5 was an error.
calibrated_scenario_assumptions.modeled_selective_adaptation_wer_effect_: Corresponds to target_primary_effect_pp=3.50 in DesignStagePowerSpec; the simulator applies -target_primary_effect_pp as the mean WER shift. The previously documented value of -1.5 was an error.
calibrated_scenario_assumptions.calibration_source: Tesla T4 Physical Hardware Calibration across Cohort 1 (N=60) and Cohort 2 (N=468) physical evaluations. Baseline WERs are hardcoded per-accent values from scripts/calibrate_stage6m_development_variance.py via src/dsg_ctta/evaluation/paired_cluster_inference.py.

inferential_procedure.study_success_definition: All 9 confirmatory hypotheses rejected simultaneously under Holm-Bonferroni correction.

decision_criteria.enforced_criterion: Exact 95% Lower Confidence Bound (LCB) on estimated joint power must satisfy LCB >= 0.90 (90.0%).

methodological_caveats_and_scope.scope_limitation: This specification pre-registers an in silico power-sizing simulation designed to evaluate whether the proposed N=220 sample size has sufficient statistical power under the declared scenario assumptions. It is NOT a physical Cohort 3 experiment or confirmatory evaluation on real audio files.
methodological_caveats_and_scope.prospective_claim_boundary: Study power is conditional on the declared between-speaker variance, paired-difference standard deviation, and hypothesized -2.00 pp disparity reduction effect. It does not guarantee real-world power if real-world speech data violates these modeling assumptions.
